About the Scholarship

Harding scholarships support doctoral research across Cambridge. Applicants are considered through their course and funding application; the current award-year terms should be checked. University of Cambridge is seeking candidates for this PhD opportunity focused on Harding Distinguished Postgraduate Scholarships. Disciplinary scope: All Subjects. The role is based in Cambridge, United Kingdom. Full funding is provided; financial support is listed as Stipend/salary rate set by the funder — see the official listing. Timing: Your Cambridge course funding deadline.

Research Areas

  • Eligible subjects across the university

Funding and Duration

ComponentDetails
FundingHome/Overseas fees and maintenance; published scheme information includes visa/IHS and a research allowance up to GBP 6,000.
MaintenanceMaintenance grant; current amount not confirmed
DurationCourse length; fourth-year maintenance may require approval

Eligibility and Requirements

PhD applicants from any country and discipline, subject to academic selection and scheme college conditions. English evidence, approved equivalents and waivers depend on the programme; IELTS is not a universal requirement for every applicant.

Application dates

ComponentDetails
RecruitmentScheme confirmed; award-year terms require confirmation
DeadlineYour Cambridge course funding deadline; current award terms must be confirmed

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Official Link

Full announcement and application portal: https://apply.postgraduate.study.cam.ac.uk/applicant/login

Source: apply.postgraduate.study.cam.ac.uk - the details in this listing were recorded from this official page.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: Your Cambridge course funding deadline - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.

How to Apply

Submit your Cambridge PhD and funding application by the course deadline, following the Harding application guidance.

The supplied funding-search record is for 2025/26. The current programme application page is available, but do not reuse old award-year amounts as 2027 guarantees.

About University of Cambridge

The University of Cambridge offers research degrees across a wide range of subjects. Doctoral applicants apply through its postgraduate portal and may be considered for university, college and partner funding.

Official details: Programme information

Application route: Application form or official instructions
